fontTokens.notes: Each of the 30 style sets declares one font shorthand plus five longhands (family/weight/size/line-height/style). Markdown h1-h3 and the table ladder are driven by --dsh-content-font-size through --dsh-content-font-delta; the UI scale and small/code variants are fixed px.

themeOverrideChecklist.note: A complete palette override only needs the tokens whose value changes between light and dark and that are not raw palette steps or fixed geometry/type scales. Static steps, radius, shadow, font and elevation tokens are theme-invariant by design; overriding alias tokens automatically flows through every var() chain.

categoryDescriptions.alias: Semantic alias layer consumed by components; the layer a theme plugin normally overrides.
categoryDescriptions.specific: Product-specific surface token (sidebar, bubble, input, menu, selector, tip).
categoryDescriptions.static: Raw palette step; theme-invariant or near-invariant, not meant to be re-themed per component.
categoryDescriptions.font: Typography token (family, markdown ladder, or UI scale).
categoryDescriptions.elevation: Composited elevation token built on the hairline stroke + soft shadows.
categoryDescriptions.other: Material / gradient / mask helper token outside the semantic alias naming scheme.
